answer: Bind each identity to one secure-enclave key that cannot be copied: the enclave signs a fresh epoch challenge, proving a distinct device stands behind the agent. Like an atlas mapping one territory to one name, the registry allows only one active identity per enclave, and revokes keys that sign contradictory claims. An attacker facing an ocean of fake accounts must then buy real hardware for every clone, so cost rises linearly from the nadir of free duplication to a price no farm can scale.
